sn22.33:1.2: “Bhikkhus, whatever is not yours, abandon it.
sn22.33:1.3: When you have abandoned it, that will lead to your welfare and happiness.
sn22.33:1.4: And what is it, bhikkhus, that is not yours?
sn22.33:1.5: Form is not yours: abandon it.
sn22.33:1.6: When you have abandoned it, that will lead to your welfare and happiness.
sn22.33:1.12: Consciousness is not yours: abandon it.
sn22.33:1.13: When you have abandoned it, that will lead to your welfare and happiness.
sn22.33:2.1: “Suppose, bhikkhus, people were to carry off the grass, sticks, branches, and foliage in this Jeta’s Grove, or to burn them, or to do with them as they wish.
sn22.33:2.3: ‘People are carrying us off, or burning us, or doing with us as they wish’?”
sn22.33:2.6: Because, venerable sir, that is neither our self nor what belongs to our self.”
sn22.33:2.7: “So too, bhikkhus, form is not yours …
sn22.33:2.13: consciousness is not yours: abandon it.
sn22.33:2.14: When you have abandoned it, that will lead to your welfare and happiness.”
